## 2. Core Service Lines & Technical Architecture

### 2.1 Web Development & Performance Engineering
- **Architecture**: React 19, Next.js 15, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Zustand.
- **Performance Benchmarks**: Sub-second First Contentful Paint (FCP < 0.8s), Largest Contentful Paint (LCP < 1.2s), Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS = 0).
- **Core Value Proposition**: 100% source code ownership. No recurring platform lock-ins (unlike Shopify or Wix).

### 2.2 Custom Enterprise ERP & CRM Development
- **Problem Solved**: Off-the-shelf software (SAP, Salesforce, Zoho) imposes high per-user monthly license fees and rigid workflows that fail local Indian manufacturers and SMEs.
- **Solution**: Tailored business operating systems with real-time PostgreSQL backends, role-based access control (RBAC), multi-location inventory tracking, automated GST billing, and WhatsApp Cloud API notification triggers.
- **Key Client Industries**: Textile mills in Tiruppur/Coimbatore, retail distributors in Udumalpet/Pollachi, agricultural processors, healthcare clinics, and educational institutions.

### 2.3 Algorithmic Trading Engines & Financial Automation
- **Capabilities**: Custom trading bots for Quotex, MetaTrader 4 (MT4), MetaTrader 5 (MT5), and crypto exchanges (Binance, Bybit).
- **Architecture**: Low-latency WebSocket feeds, Python (asyncio/Telethon), Node.js, C++ MQL5, automated martingale/fixed-fraction risk management, sub-50ms execution speed.

### 2.4 Telegram Bot Development & Automated VIP Paywalls
- **Features**: Automated signal forwarding from master VIP channels, Razorpay UPI & USDT Crypto (TRC20/BEP20) payment verification, single-use invite link generation, subscription expiry tracking, and Telegram Mini Apps (TMAs).

### 2.5 Digital Marketing & Local SEO Dominance
- **Service Radius**: Udumalpet, Pollachi, Tiruppur, Coimbatore, Erode, Salem, Madurai, Chennai, and Pan-India.
- **Services**: High-intent Google Search Ads, Meta performance ads, Google Business Profile (GBP) ranking optimization, local citation building, and programmatic technical SEO.

2. **Professional Growth Software Platform — ₹49,999 INR**:
